Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to the obligations of regional governments that must be regulated in regional regulations: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA that organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of the Central Government and Regional Governments are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, in an integrated and integrated manner. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Governments are obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to the obligations of regional governments that must be regulated in regional regulations: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA that organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of the Central Government and Regional Governments are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, in an integrated and integrated manner. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Governments are obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to the obligations of regional governments that must be regulated in regional regulations: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA that organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of the Central Government and Regional Governments are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, in an integrated and integrated manner. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Governments are obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to the obligations of regional governments that must be regulated in regional regulations: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA that organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of the Central Government and Regional Governments are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, in an integrated and integrated manner. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Governments are obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to the obligations of regional governments that must be regulated in regional regulations: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA that organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of the Central Government and Regional Governments are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, in an integrated and integrated manner. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Governments are obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Article 82

The Central Government and Regional Governments are obliged to conduct regular and continuous coordination for Victims.

At the provincial government level, Regional Regulation of West Nusa Tenggara Province Number 8 of 2015 concerning Implementation of Protection of Women and Children has been promulgated. There are several obligations contained in the Regional Regulation related to regency obligations. 1). formulation of regional regulations and regional head regulations in regencies/cities concerning Protection of Women and Children, 2). Formation of a Coordination Team for Protection of Women and Children at the regency/city level.

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to the obligations of regional governments that must be regulated in regional regulations: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA that organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of the Central Government and Regional Governments are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, in an integrated and integrated manner. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Governments are obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Article 9

The implementation of Protection of Women as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:

a. efforts to improve family quality,
b. efforts to fulfill special needs of women, c. efforts to prevent and Protect Women victims of Violence, Exploitation, and Discrimination in a fast, integrated, and coordinated manner, and
d. efforts to Protect Women in disaster situations.

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to the obligations of regional governments that must be regulated in regional regulations: 1). Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to the obligations of regional governments that must be regulated in regional regulations: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA that organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of the Central Government and Regional Governments are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, in an integrated and integrated manner. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Governments are obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to the obligations of regional governments that must be regulated in regional regulations: 1). Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN

GENERAL

l.

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to the obligations of regional governments that must be regulated in regional regulations: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA that organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of the Central Government and Regional Governments are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, in an integrated and integrated manner. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Governments are obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

BY THE GRACE OF ALMIGHTY GOD THE REGENT OF CENTRAL LOMBOK,

Considering that women and children are God's creatures and assets of the nation who must be protected, respected, and have their human rights fulfilled by the State, law and government to obtain true welfare as stated in Pancasila and the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia; that women and children require protection from various forms of violence, exploitation, child marriage, and neglect, there is a need for strategic efforts from the Regional Government and other parties who are obligated to provide protection for women and children; that Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency Number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of Children and Women Victims of Violence is no longer in accordance with the development of laws and policies on the protection of women and children established by the government and provincial government and therefore needs to be replaced; that based on the considerations referred to in letters a, b and c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children.

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to the obligations of regional governments that must be regulated in regional regulations: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA that organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of the Central Government and Regional Governments are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, in an integrated and integrated manner. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Governments are obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to the obligations of regional governments that must be regulated in regional regulations: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA that organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of the Central Government and Regional Governments are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, in an integrated and integrated manner. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Governments are obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services. In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Changes have also occurred in law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children through two amendments, namely 1). law number 35 of 2014 concerning amendments to the law number concerning Protection of children, and 2. Stipulation of Government Regulation in Lieu of Law Number 1 of 2016 Concerning the Second Amendment to Law Number 23 of 2002 Concerning Protection of Children into Law. There are a number of obligations of regional governments contained in this law that must be further regulated by regional regulations. Changes to law number 23 of 2022 concerning Protection of children certainly have legal implications for child Protection legal policy in Central Lombok regency.

In the aspect of Protection of women, significant changes occurred when law number 12 of 2022 concerning the criminal act of sexual violence was promulgated. There are several provisions related to the obligations of regional governments that must be regulated in regional regulations: 1). Provisions of Article 76 paragraph (2) Provincial and regency/city Regional Governments are obliged to establish UPTD PPA that organizes Handling, Protection, and Recovery of Victims, Victims' Families, and/or Witnesses, 2). Article 79 paragraph (1) obligation of the Central Government and Regional Governments are obliged to organize Prevention of Criminal Acts of Sexual Violence quickly, in an integrated and integrated manner. 3). Article 80 paragraph (1) Regional Governments are obliged to organize education and training for law enforcement officials, government service personnel, and service personnel at Community-Based Service Provider Institutions, 4).

In the appendix to Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the division of regency government affairs in the field of women's empowerment and child protection is regulated in more detail. The field of women includes the following authorities: a). Prevention of violence against women involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b). Provision of services for women victims of violence requiring coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing Protection services for women at the regency/city Region level. Field. Quality of Life of Women includes, Institutionalization of gender mainstreaming at regional government institutions at the regency/city Region level. b. Empowerment of women in the political, legal, social and economic fields in community organizations at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening and development of institutions providing women's empowerment services at the regency/city Region level. Field of Fulfillment of Children's Rights (PHA), includes: Institutionalization of PHA in government, non-government institutions, and the business world at the regency/city Region level, Strengthening and development of service provider institutions for improving the quality of children's lives at the regency/city Region level. Field of Protection of children in special circumstances includes, a. Prevention of violence against children involving parties within the scope of the regency/city Region. b. Provision of services for children requiring special Protection that requires coordination at the regency/city Region level. c. Strengthening the development of service provider institutions for children requiring special Protection at the regency/city Region level.

Regional Regulation of Central Lombok Regency number 3 of 2009 concerning Protection of children and women victims of violence has been in force for approximately 14 years. During the period of its validity, there have been many changes in policies and laws and regulations in the field of Protection of children and women, whether adopted by the central government, provincial government or Central Lombok regency government. Therefore, at the regency regional regulation level, adjustments need to be made so that the Central Lombok regency government has a legal basis for implementing policies and programs in the field of Protection of women and children.

The field of regional government has undergone changes with the revocation of Law Number 32 of 2004 concerning Regional Government by Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government. Based on article 12 of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government, the affairs of women's empowerment and child protection constitute Mandatory Government Affairs that are not related to Basic Services.
